title: In Medio Stat Virtus: intermediate levels of mind wandering improve episodic memory encoding in a virtual environment
authors: Blondé, P., Makowski, D., Sperduti, M., & Piolino, P.
summary: Mind wandering usually costs memory, but not in a straight line. In a virtual environment, memory for what happened was best at intermediate levels of mind wandering rather than at the lowest.
